take_homes: The AI can keep my depot reports as files and answer with file names, so I can check it. Not just a chatbot.
A morning page that makes itself every day in our company look. I could show it to the depot managers.
Most of what we know about the depots is only in people's heads, and the AI knows nothing of it unless somebody writes it down.
